content.content: When invoked as `deccy log`, the deccy CLI shall write one line to stdout per node as `<id> <kind> <summary>`.
content.rationale: Pipes and agents need scannable handles per node; full JSON per node re-emits show output and breaks line-per-node greppability, while ids-only drops the summary handles S3-log exists to supply. One `<id> <kind> <summary>` line keeps the report greppable under O5's line discipline. States only the rendering fact without re-deciding D16b's set read, its no-ordering rule, S3-log's description source, O4's status rule, or O5's channel rules.
